name: Invaders MC
description: The Invaders MC is a one-percenter outlaw motorcycle club founded on October 31, 1965, in Gary, Indiana, with early members who went on to serve in Vietnam. The club expanded to over a dozen chapters across Indiana, Illinois, Missouri, and Colorado, and is recognizable by its trademark white vests and "Green Monster" center patch. In 2009, fifteen members were federally indicted for conspiring to distribute approximately 2,200 pounds of marijuana between 1994 and 2009.
